title: Contravariant six-term Ext exact sequence
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with small Ext groups [def-pc-ext], let $Y\in\mathcal A$, and let $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ be short exact. For $n\geq0$ the sequence $\operatorname{Ext}^{n}(C,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n}(B,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n}(A,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}(C,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}(B,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}(A,Y)$ is exact. The within-degree arrows are precomposition with $g$ and $f$; the connecting arrow is composition with the extension class of the given short exact sequence.
